esqlQuery.esql:
FROM chargeback_lookup.billing_cluster_cost
| EVAL threshold_budget = 25000.0, budget_currency = "", currency_budgets = "", threshold_pct = 80.0, alert_on_projected = true
| WHERE @timestamp IS NOT NULL
| INLINE STATS latest_ts = MAX(@timestamp)
| WHERE @timestamp > latest_ts - 30 days
| EVAL ts = @timestamp
| EVAL is_onprem_row = COALESCE(is_onprem, ess.billing.deployment_type IN ("onprem", "ece", "eck") OR cloud.provider == "onprem", false), cloud_cfg_key = "chargeback_config"
| LOOKUP JOIN chargeback_lookup.chargeback_conf ON cloud_cfg_key == config_join_key AND ts >= conf_start_date AND ts <= conf_end_date
| EVAL cloud_rate = conf_chargeable_unit_rate, cloud_unit = conf_chargeable_unit_rate_unit
| DROP config_join_key, conf_start_date, conf_end_date, conf_chargeable_unit_rate, conf_chargeable_unit_rate_unit
| LOOKUP JOIN chargeback_lookup.chargeback_currency ON cloud_cfg_key == config_join_key AND ts >= conf_start_date AND ts <= conf_end_date
| EVAL cloud_sym = conf_currency_symbol, cloud_sym_unit = conf_currency_unit
| DROP cloud_cfg_key, config_join_key, conf_start_date, conf_end_date, conf_currency_symbol, conf_currency_unit
| EVAL onprem_cfg_key = CASE(is_onprem_row, "chargeback_config_onprem", null)
| LOOKUP JOIN chargeback_lookup.chargeback_conf ON onprem_cfg_key == config_join_key AND ts >= conf_start_date AND ts <= conf_end_date
| EVAL onprem_rate = conf_chargeable_unit_rate, onprem_unit = conf_chargeable_unit_rate_unit
| DROP config_join_key, conf_start_date, conf_end_date, conf_chargeable_unit_rate, conf_chargeable_unit_rate_unit
| LOOKUP JOIN chargeback_lookup.chargeback_currency ON onprem_cfg_key == config_join_key AND ts >= conf_start_date AND ts <= conf_end_date
| EVAL onprem_sym = conf_currency_symbol, onprem_sym_unit = conf_currency_unit
| DROP onprem_cfg_key, config_join_key, conf_start_date, conf_end_date, conf_currency_symbol, conf_currency_unit
| EVAL _c_unit = CASE(LENGTH(TRIM(cloud_unit)) > 0, TO_UPPER(TRIM(cloud_unit)), null),
       _c_sym_u = CASE(LENGTH(TRIM(cloud_sym_unit)) > 0, TO_UPPER(TRIM(cloud_sym_unit)), null),
       _o_has_row = (onprem_rate IS NOT NULL),
       _o_unit = CASE(LENGTH(TRIM(onprem_unit)) > 0, TO_UPPER(TRIM(onprem_unit)), null),
       _o_sym_u = CASE(LENGTH(TRIM(onprem_sym_unit)) > 0, TO_UPPER(TRIM(onprem_sym_unit)), null)
| EVAL _c_sym = CASE(LENGTH(TRIM(cloud_sym)) > 0 AND (_c_sym_u IS NULL OR _c_sym_u == COALESCE(_c_unit, "EUR")), TRIM(cloud_sym), null),
       _o_eff_u = CASE(_o_has_row, COALESCE(_o_unit, _c_unit, "EUR"), "EUR")
| EVAL _o_sym = CASE(LENGTH(TRIM(onprem_sym)) > 0 AND (_o_sym_u IS NULL OR _o_sym_u == _o_eff_u), TRIM(onprem_sym), null),
       rate = CASE(is_onprem_row, COALESCE(onprem_rate, 0.00085), COALESCE(cloud_rate, 0.85)),
       unit = CASE(is_onprem_row, _o_eff_u, COALESCE(_c_unit, "EUR"))
| EVAL _def_sym = CASE(unit == "USD", "$", unit == "GBP", "£", unit == "ZAR", "R", "€")
| EVAL currency_symbol = CASE(
    is_onprem_row,
    CASE(_o_sym IS NOT NULL, _o_sym, _o_has_row AND _o_unit IS NULL AND _c_sym IS NOT NULL, _c_sym, _c_sym IS NOT NULL AND _c_unit == unit, _c_sym, _def_sym),
    CASE(_c_sym IS NOT NULL, _c_sym, _def_sym)
  )
| EVAL units = COALESCE(total_chargeable_units, 0.0)
| EVAL cost = units * rate
| EVAL bill_day = DATE_TRUNC(1 day, ts)
| EVAL active_dep = CASE(cost > 0 AND deployment_id IS NOT NULL AND deployment_id != "" AND NOT STARTS_WITH(deployment_id, "deleted_or_unassociated") AND NOT STARTS_WITH(deployment_id, "unassociated") AND deployment_id != "organization", deployment_id, null)
| STATS
    spend = ROUND(SUM(cost), 2),
    units_total = ROUND(SUM(units), 2),
    billed_days = COUNT_DISTINCT(bill_day),
    active_deployments = COUNT_DISTINCT(active_dep),
    latest_day = LEFT(TO_STRING(MAX(ts)), 10),
    default_budget = MAX(threshold_budget),
    cfg_budget_curr = MAX(budget_currency),
    cfg_curr_budgets = MAX(currency_budgets),
    warn_pct = MAX(threshold_pct),
    check_proj = MAX(alert_on_projected),
    sym = COALESCE(MAX(currency_symbol), "€")
  BY unit
| INLINE STATS active_currencies = COUNT(CASE(spend > 0.0, 1, null))
| EVAL _cb_entries = MV_APPEND(SPLIT(REPLACE(TO_UPPER(COALESCE(cfg_curr_budgets, "")), " ", ""), ","), "_FALLBACK_:0")
| MV_EXPAND _cb_entries
| DISSECT _cb_entries "%{_cb_u}:%{_cb_v}"
| EVAL _matched_budget = CASE(_cb_u == unit, TO_DOUBLE(_cb_v), null)
| STATS
    spend = MAX(spend),
    units_total = MAX(units_total),
    billed_days = MAX(billed_days),
    active_deployments = MAX(active_deployments),
    latest_day = MAX(latest_day),
    explicit_budget = MAX(_matched_budget),
    default_budget = MAX(default_budget),
    cfg_budget_curr = MAX(cfg_budget_curr),
    active_currencies = MAX(active_currencies),
    warn_pct = MAX(warn_pct),
    check_proj = MAX(check_proj),
    sym = MAX(sym)
  BY unit
| EVAL norm_bcurr = TO_UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(cfg_budget_curr, "")))
| EVAL threshold = COALESCE(explicit_budget, CASE(norm_bcurr != "" AND norm_bcurr == unit, default_budget, active_currencies == 1 AND norm_bcurr == "" AND spend > 0.0, default_budget, null))
| EVAL has_matching_budget = (threshold IS NOT NULL AND threshold > 0.0)
| EVAL budget_used_pct = CASE(has_matching_budget, ROUND(spend * 100.0 / threshold, 1), 0.0)
| EVAL daily_avg_spend = CASE(billed_days > 0, ROUND(spend / TO_DOUBLE(billed_days), 2), 0.0)
| EVAL projected_30d_spend = ROUND(daily_avg_spend * 30.0, 2)
| EVAL projected_pct = CASE(has_matching_budget, ROUND(projected_30d_spend * 100.0 / threshold, 1), 0.0)
| WHERE (has_matching_budget AND (budget_used_pct >= warn_pct OR (check_proj == true AND billed_days >= 3 AND projected_30d_spend > threshold)))
     OR (NOT has_matching_budget AND spend > 0.0)
| EVAL breach_reason = CASE(
    NOT has_matching_budget, "missing_currency_budget",
    spend > threshold, "budget_exceeded",
    budget_used_pct >= warn_pct, "watermark_reached",
    "projected_30d_overrun"
  )
| EVAL result = CASE(
    NOT has_matching_budget,
    CONCAT("[", latest_day, "] Organization 30d spend of ", sym, TO_STRING(spend), " ", unit, " (", TO_STRING(units_total), " chargeable units across ", TO_STRING(active_deployments), " active deployments over ", TO_STRING(billed_days), "d) triggered missing_currency_budget (configure ", unit, ":<amount> in currency_budgets)."),
    CONCAT("[", latest_day, "] Organization 30d spend of ", sym, TO_STRING(spend), " ", unit, " (", TO_STRING(budget_used_pct), "% of ", sym, TO_STRING(threshold), " ", unit, " budget; ", TO_STRING(units_total), " chargeable units across ", TO_STRING(active_deployments), " active deployments over ", TO_STRING(billed_days), "d; avg ", sym, TO_STRING(daily_avg_spend), "/day, projected 30d: ", sym, TO_STRING(projected_30d_spend), " ", unit, " / ", TO_STRING(projected_pct), "%) triggered ", breach_reason, " (watermark: ", TO_STRING(warn_pct), "%).")
  )
| SORT unit ASC
| KEEP result, latest_day, breach_reason, billed_days, active_deployments, spend, budget_used_pct, daily_avg_spend, projected_30d_spend, projected_pct, units_total, threshold, warn_pct, unit
